newsitem.title: USA: Florida Power Tiger Bay purchase cleared.
newsitem.headline: Florida Power Tiger Bay purchase cleared.

text.p: Florida Power Corp said Wednesday it has reached an agreement with intervenors clearing its planned purchase of the Tiger Bay cogeneration facility in Ft. Meade, Fla.

The Florida Progress Corp subsidiary said the filing of a joint motion for approval of this stipulation with the state Public Service Commission Monday put it one step closer to completing the purchase one of the state's most efficient power plants.
Florida Power reached the stipulation with the Office of Public Counsel and the Florida Industrial Power Users Group.

In late January, the utility noted, it agreed to purchase of the 220-megawatt plant for $445 million from Tiger Bay LP, owned by Destec Energy Inc, Energy Investors Fund and General Peat. Destec has since agreed to be acquired by NGC Corp.

The proposed transaction is scheduled to close in July, Florida Power said. The Tiger Bay facility, which uses advanced gas-fired, combined-cycle technology, began commercial operation in January 1995.

The utility said the purchase will not will not affect its current rates and will result in termination of a 30-year contract. Florida Power will recover the purchase price by continuing to collect under the current purchase power agreement with the facility.

This strategy will eliminate 18 years of the contract and result in an estimated savings to Florida Power customers between $2 billion and $2.4 billion for the years 2008 through 2025, it said. ((-- Jim Brumm 212-859-1710.))
